name: Creature of the Void
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
It seems the consensus that you are ready to learn to summon a voidwalker.

A being created of the chaos that lies beyond, if you summon one but cannot control it, you will be torn asunder.

The first voidwalker was summoned by Egalin, and in his grimoire is the process explained.

Unfortunately, it was stolen from us by an agent of the Scarlet Crusade who has it secreted away in his base at a tower to the west. Bring it to me, and I will impart the knowledge to you.
narrative.objectives: Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, this is excellent. Like as not, Perrine was ignorant to the true power of the musty book he had stolen from us.

It will not fall out of our hands again. Observe, adventurer, the structure of the spell, the manner in which your power must be channeled.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Egalin was the teacher that taught me. With hardly a look, he was able to command the voidwalker he had summoned.

When it came my turn to try, I was overconfident. Do not trifle with the powers that you wield, adventurer, they can consume even the vigilant.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
